command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-body-sourceover-v2.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-gpt56sol-avatar-body-sourceover-v2-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
SCRIPT="$TMP/repo/handoff/avatar-body-shoulder-microkinematics-20260912/body_crossfade_sourceover_identity_v2.py"

sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" "$ROOT/buehne_daemon.py" "$ROOT/koerper_rgba/koerper_zero.png" > "$OUT/before.sha256"

import json,sys
r=json.loads(open(sys.argv[1]).read().splitlines()[-1]); assert not r.get('error'),r; assert r['gl_error']==0,r

for d,fams in r['directions'].items():
 for fam,x in fams.items(): rows.append((d,fam,x))
summary={
 'max_rgba_mae':max(x['max_rgba_mae'] for _,_,x in rows),
 'max_rgba_max':max(x['max_rgba_max'] for _,_,x in rows),
 'max_alpha_mae':max(x['max_alpha_mae'] for _,_,x in rows),
 'max_deep_hole_px':max(x['max_deep_hole_px'] for _,_,x in rows),
 'min_jaccard':min(x['min_jaccard'] for _,_,x in rows),
 'tests':sum(x['tests'] for _,_,x in rows),
}

PY
